scoring_notes: Woodward is a tier-2/3 subsystem supplier (propulsion controls, actuation). 10-K names platforms (F-35, F-15, Blackhawk, Apache, smart defense weapons) without PE-level revenue attribution. Apply J-Book heuristics: a platform's UNFUNDED status only flows to SEVERE/RED for Woodward if the platform represented material disclosed revenue. Since 10-K says no customer >=10% of consolidated sales, downgrade scoring tier by 1 vs prime-contractor case (materiality test #2). The most informative J-Book hit is F-15 (multiple R-2 PEs UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR / UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS) — Woodward's named F-15 forward-content claim is materially weakened. F-35 is FUNDED_STEADY at $1.18B (C2D2) which validates the F-35 claim.

scores.M_value: primary_match=F-35 C2D2 (PE 0604840F), status=FUNDED_STEADY, FY24=$1236.7M, FY25=$1134.2M, FY26=$1182.1M. Secondary F-35 Squadrons (PE 0207142F) FUNDED_STEADY FY26=$48.4M.
scores.interpretation: F-35 development+squadron support PEs are FUNDED_STEADY in FY26 J-Book. The forward-revenue narrative tied to F-35 content is corroborated by the budget; no J-Book divergence. PASS.

pentagon_jbook: F-15 EPAWSS (PE 0207171F) UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS — FY24=$13.0M, FY25=$0, FY26=$0 (no replacement_program)

scores.M_value: 4 matched F-15 PEs: EPAWSS=UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, F-15E Squadrons=UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR, F-15EX=UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR, F-15 procurement=UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR. Across the F-15 family, every R-2/P-40 line tracked is showing zero or near-zero forward funding in the FY26 J-Book.
scores.interpretation: The F-15 forward-revenue narrative diverges from the J-Book: four distinct F-15 PEs show UNFUNDED status. Per heuristic #1, the worst PE status (UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS on EPAWSS) maps to RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE, but materiality test #2 applies: Woodward only claims 'significant content' (platform-supplier, sub-tier) and discloses no single customer >10% of sales, so this is platform-list exposure, not a quantified prime-contract claim. Downgrade two tiers from RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE → MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY. Forward F-15 procurement/sustainment dollars are clearly drying up across multiple line items, weakening the platform-content narrative for FY26+.

_summary.headline_finding: F-15 platform forward funding is materially impaired across 4 PEs (EPAWSS UNFUNDED_2+Y, F-15EX/F-15E Squadrons/F-15 procurement UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR). Woodward names F-15 as significant-content. Counterbalanced by F-35 C2D2 FUNDED_STEADY at $1.18B FY26 and missile programs FUNDED_GROWING/STEADY. Net: modest J-Book divergence on F-15 line, no existential PE-revenue divergence given Woodward's diffuse tier-2 customer mix.
